name: MiniMenu
description: Small utility mod: noclip, hitboxes, trajectory, replay bot.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Ignore death. Also puts the level in test mode so nothing is submitted.

trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
trajectory.description: Draws predicted paths for holding and not holding.

trajectory-debug.name: Trajectory Debug Text
trajectory-debug.description: Shows steps simulated, distance moved, and whether the sim died.

trajectory-time-scale.name: Trajectory Time Scale
trajectory-time-scale.description: Multiplier on the simulation step. If the path is a tiny dot, try 60.

trajectory-solid-death.name: Trajectory: Predict Wall Crashes
trajectory-solid-death.description: Also ends the path where you would crash into the side of a block.

bot-debug.name: Bot Debug Text
bot-debug.description: Shows frame / input counters while recording or replaying.

speedhack.name: Speedhack
speedhack.description: Game speed multiplier. Anything other than 1.0 puts levels in test mode.

bot-frame-fix.name: Replay Frame Fix
bot-frame-fix.description: During replay, snap the player back to the recorded position, rotation and vertical speed every step if it drifted.

trajectory-with-bot.name: Trajectory While Bot Is Active
trajectory-with-bot.description: Off by default: the trajectory simulation can change real object state and desync recordings.

bot-any-level.name: Replay On Any Level
bot-any-level.description: Let a macro play on a different level (copy, layout version). Off = only the level it was recorded on.

bot-mode.name: Replay Bot
bot-mode.description: Record inputs, or replay them. Replay mode puts the level in test mode.
